name: example_reporter
description: A third party's plugin, written as files alone: a device sends datagrams reporting the bytes of connections it saw, the plugin decodes them in its script into its own table, and a derivation joins them to the logged connections and counts them as a measure of its own, served by every widget declaring volumes and by the widget it carries. Like every figure opnview draws, the measure is a lower bound: traffic between two clients behind one interface is in none of its figures.

measures.name: example_reported
measures.label: plugin.example_reporter.measure.example_reported
measures.description: The bytes and packets the reporting device counted for each direction of a logged connection. A second measure beside the logged one, never summed with it; a lower bound, and traffic between two clients behind one interface is in none of its figures.

settings.label: plugin.example_reporter.setting.lookback_seconds
settings.note: How long before its first report the device is taken to have been reporting: the start of the window the measure covers.
